notes: ABIs: arm64-v8a only. Every other enginehost plugin ships x86_64 beside it; this one cannot yet. The engine links eighteen static libraries out of Kirikiroid2Yuri's prebuilt dependency tree, and upstream publishes that tree for aarch64 alone (the deps release carries one thirdparty_build.tar.gz, which unpacks to thirdparty/build/arch_androida64), while script/_androida64.sh names aarch64-linux-android and -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a at every one of its call sites. An x86_64 bundle needs that dependency set built for x86_64 first -- ffmpeg, opencv (whose arm-only libtegra_hal.a has no x86_64 counterpart), openal, breakpad, libarchive, cocos2d-x and the rest -- which is a dependency-toolchain port, not an ABI flag.
